reply.subject: Re: Your Growth Blueprint and page content are ready
reply.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for going through the deck with Dr. Lund. I'm glad the overall direction and the sitemap feel right.

Your point about emergency care is an important one. Our SEO lead will review the keyword priorities with dental and wellness in mind, and I'll come back to you before we change the Blueprint. The same goes for the Fear Free wording: we will review it so the positioning only says what is true.

We will remove the anesthesia-free cleanings from the dental care page and correct Dr. Ruiz's name on the About page.

A Sisters page would be a second location page, which goes beyond what the current agreement covers. I'll send you a change order for it, and work on the agreed pages carries on meanwhile.

The inner page designs come next; I'll confirm when you'll see them once the design team has scheduled them.

Thanks again,
